classification_rules.note: Scope is the user's declared grouping carried in each bound snapshot's frozen user calculation method; this package maps a binding role to a reporting category, it does not decide numbers or emit a GHG-Protocol statement. This demonstration package declares only scope_1 because the reviewed public foreground data yields onsite (scope_1) contributions only; a package may declare scope_2/scope_3 once background/offsite contributions are attributed, and any declared scope must actually be populated.

limitations: The organization inventory reports the user's declared Scope grouping of engine contributions; it is not a regulatory filing value.
Foreground-only coverage means background supply-chain emissions are not yet attributed and are reported as gaps, never zeroed.
